newsitem.title: USA: Game Financial files for 2 million shares.
newsitem.headline: Game Financial files for 2 million shares.

text.p: Game Financial Corp said Friday it filed a registration with the Securities and Exchange Commission to sell up to two million common shares.
Of the total, 1.7 million common shares will be offered by the company and 300,000 common shares will be sold by selling shareholders, the filing said.
The underwriters have been granted a 30-day over-allotment option to purchase up to 300,000 additional common shares. The offering will be made through John G. Kinnard & Co Inc.
Game offers proprietary GameCash services to comprehensive cash access solutions to casinos and other establishments.
